title: Evidence attestation
description: attestation.json in an evidence/v1 export: the runner-signed statement of what a Closed change did, made at Close. Not expressible here and checked by the verifier: the file is the canonical JSON form; the signature verifies over the canonical form without the signature; every field that restates the chain (change_id, sequence range, head_record_hash, digests, actors, approval_ev_ids, verifier_results) equals what the records derive; first_sequence is at most last_sequence; actors are sorted by principal then kind; credential_scopes is sorted without duplicates and its first entry is the digest of the rest; at most 1024 entries in each list; executor_id and model_id are at most 256 bytes of valid UTF-8; every ASCII string is at most 256 bytes; the file is at most 1 MiB. ticket, signature and signing_key_id are optional in the shipped Go struct but the decoder rejects an attestation without them, so the schema requires them.

ticket.description: The ticket leaf: the literal none, or a reference of 1 to 128 printable ASCII characters without space or # followed by # and the digest of the ticket.

executor_id.description: Executor identity; free text of at most 256 bytes, absent when none.

model_id.description: Model identity; free text of at most 256 bytes, absent when none.

credential_scopes.description: Empty or absent when the broker made no statement. Otherwise the first entry is the broker digest line and the rest are sorted handle scope lines.

canon_version.description: The checkpoint-family canonical-form version; 1 in evidence/v1.

digest.description: A SHA-256 digest: the prefix sha256: and 64 lowercase hex characters.

sequence.description: A chain sequence number, at most 2^53-1.

asciiText.description: Printable ASCII, no leading or trailing space, at most 256 bytes (the length bound is not expressible here).

signature.description: An Ed25519 signature: 64 raw bytes as standard padded base64, 88 characters ending ==.

networkPolicy.description: The egress proxy statement: ref is egress-policy.v1/ followed by the attestation's own change_id (that it is this attestation's change is checked by the verifier, not here) and sha256 the digest of the proxy's egress policy record.

ref.description: A reference of at most 1024 bytes with no .. path segment; the length bound and the segment rule are not expressible here.

credentialScopeEntry.description: Either the broker digest line (broker.scopes.v1 sha256:<hex>, which must be the first entry and appear once) or a handle scope line (nhref_<12 hex> <scope>:<value>).

inclusionProof.description: A Merkle inclusion proof (RFC 6962). leaf_index is below tree_size and audit_path has exactly the length the two numbers imply (at most 64 entries); the schema cannot express either.
